title: Hen Wen's Death music mod
description: This mod lets you play a sound file uppon death
body:
This mod lets you play a random custom .ogg file upon death, and it stops once you respawn or go to the title screen. you can also toggle on an off certain sounds that you put in without having to remove them, directly inside the mod. there is also a volume slider inside the mod, just incase your sounds are too loud.



(if it doesent work, just keep in mind i vibe coded this)
